description:
Returns one place by its geoHash and id, as returned by search_places: name, category, address, coordinates, contacts and whether it takes bookings on Pinsvit, plus opening hours, description and images when a business runs it there; no authentication.
A bookable place is booked with get_place_services, find_booking_times and create_booking; for any other place give the user the address, web links and whatever hours the record holds.
contacts are every contact the business wrote; a place nobody runs on Pinsvit carries web links only. Not found means the place was removed or has just been claimed: search again.

geoHash.description: geoHash of the place, returned next to its id by search_places.

name: get_place

bookable.description: True when the place takes bookings on Pinsvit; the booking tools work only then. False: tell the user how to reach the place instead.

contacts.description: Contact lines: every one the business wrote (phone, email, website); a place nobody runs on Pinsvit carries web links only.

description.description: Description written by the business; absent when none.

id.description: Place id; identifies the place together with geoHash.

medias.description: Public URLs of the place's images.

openHours.description: Weekly opening periods (day 1 = Monday, times HH:mm local); a weekday with no period is closed. Absent when unknown: never invent hours.

status.description: The venue's operating status as imported, e.g. open or closed; absent when unknown.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the opening hours are in, e.g. Europe/Kyiv; absent when unknown.

url.description: Public page of the place; absent when it has none.

title: Get place
